1820.s: Sir Arinbiorn thought at first, that there was indeed a warrior thus attired leaning against the wall ; but soon after perceived that the headpiece was void; and yet he could not repress certain thoughts of ambuscade and stratagem, in consequence of which perhaps his own armour might ere long be hung up in the cave as this was now !
